NAV S$10,354,132 (watcher -0.62%; listed -3.23% — stale baseline, see notes)

  • Biggest mover (Mon, verified): US semis — DRAM -7%, SOXX -5.5% (MRVL -7.5%, INTC -5.5%, NVDA -3.5%) after Anthropic CEO Amodei's AI-slowdown essay backed by Musk/Altman/Hassabis. In-book: SMIC -2.9% to HK$61.30 (5th down day); CDL S$8.15 (~-4.1% Monday per CDL IR); Xiaomi +3.0%, Tencent +0.5% diverged higher.
  • The one thing: FOMC decision ~2:00am SGT Thursday — CME FedWatch 93% priced for a 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% (first since Jul 2023, first under Chair Warsh). 10y UST breached 5.01% intraday Monday (first >5% since Oct 2023), settled ~4.99%.

Watcher flags: 8 critical — all stale-baseline artifacts

  • Verified Monday moves vs flags: SMIC -2.93% (flag -10.2%), silver ~-1% (flag -6.3%), SILJ $29.39 -3.8% (flag -7.3%), GDX ~$94.40 -2.8% (flag -5.2%), CDL S$8.15 (flag -5.2% = Friday-vs-Sep-4 math; cumulative from Sep 4 now ~-9%). Flags compare vs ~Sep 4 baselines, not Monday. Slow bleed, not crash.
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2702; implied USDCNY ~6.70. priceErrors: L46.SI feed still down (3rd session). NAV history reconciles flat: 10,352,814 → 10,354,132 (+0.01%).

Insider trades (SGX/HK, 7d)

  • None found for held names Sep 8-15 (SGX announcements/web + HKEX checks on DBS, F&N, VICOM, Straits Trading, CDL, UOL, Wing Tai, Yanlord, Ho Bee, Seatrium, YZJ, Singtel, Keppel REIT, Tencent, SMIC, Xiaomi). US holdings are ETFs — no insider reports exist. None surfaced is not proof of absence.

Congress trades

  • BeltwayIQ week-38: 0 filings so far (week in progress; w37 also zero). Source
  • Capitol Trades feed, disclosed Mon Sep 14 (US): Rep. John Rose (R-TN) sold AMCPX $500K-1M and GOOGL $250K-500K; Rep. Thomas Kean Jr (R-NJ) sold GOOGL, AMCR, JNJ ($1K-15K each). All sells, all House GOP; trade dates not shown (45-day STOCK Act lag). Source

Policy watch

  • AI fight: Trump on Truth Social — "SICK conspiracy against AI and Data Centers… WHOEVER WINS AI, WINS!" — rejecting the Amodei/Altman/Musk/Hassabis slowdown push; Vance calls it a "Trojan Horse". Xi pitched a China-led AI ecosystem at BRICS. Source
  • FOMC eve: 93% priced hike to 3.75-4.00% Thu 2am SGT; Deutsche Bank sees a "baby cycle" (+1.14pp avg to 10y over 12m); BOJ Friday. Source
  • Iran war: Saudi East-West pipeline (4-5m bpd, ~4% of global supply) shut Sep 11 after drone attacks from Iraq; repair est. 3-5 weeks. Hormuz vessel struck; US sanctions on a Russian bank; Vance confirms direct Houthi talks. Brent ~$106-108. Source
  • Canada: Section 338 product additions/removals effective TODAY Sep 15; import bans Sep 29 — second supply-side price impulse in FOMC week. Source

Risk

  • Event risk: 93% priced = asymmetric surprise on a hold; hawkish guidance = one more de-rating leg for HK tech / SGX property / miners.
  • Margin: IBKR silver line 1,777 oz x ~$63.6 x 1.2702 ≈ S$143.6k position vs ~S$56.2k loan (~1.5x; equity ~S$87k). Silver held $63-64 through the repricing; post-FOMC flush <$60 starts to matter.
  • Concentration/FX: ~62% of liquid book idle cash; ~35% of net worth non-SGD.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Defense sleeve (15% vs ~0%): 10y 5.01% printed the trigger a day early — post-statement ≥5% starts the tranche build; surprise hold = stand down.
  • Silver/SLVP/SILJ (20% vs ~4%): sell-rumor-buy-news — hike lands + $62-64 holds = reload zone; clean break <$60 = wait.
  • HK AI (SMIC/Tencent/Xiaomi): essay selloff is sentiment, not capex (~US$733bn intact; IGV +5% same day). Xiaomi +3%/Tencent +0.5% diverging; SMIC -19% from Aug 18 vs ~HK$94 target; Huawei-backed DUV tools in SMIC testing. Post-FOMC stabilization = staggered small tranches.

trumpWatch.title: Trump rejects AI-slowdown push: 'SICK conspiracy… WHOEVER WINS AI, WINS!'
trumpWatch.detail: Amodei's Saturday essay ('we must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models') was backed by Altman, Musk and Hassabis; Trump answered Monday on Truth Social defending AI and data centers vs China. VP Vance called the industry push 'a little bit of a Trojan Horse'. Xi separately proposed a China-led AI ecosystem at the BRICS summit. Net: administration defends the data-center buildout — hardware demand intact, regulatory risk shifts to the model layer.

trumpWatch.title: FOMC decision Thu 2:00am SGT — 93% priced hike, first since Jul 2023
trumpWatch.detail: CME FedWatch: 93% for +25bp to 3.75-4.00% (first hike since July 2023; first under Chair Warsh; presser 2:30am SGT). August CPI matched expectations Friday. 10y UST breached 5.01% intraday Monday (first >5% since Oct 2023), settled ~4.99%. Deutsche Bank: hiking cycles add ~+1.14pp to the 10y over 12m on average but expects a 'baby cycle'. BOJ decides Friday.

trumpWatch.title: Iran war: Saudi East-West pipeline shut 3-5 weeks; Hormuz vessel struck
trumpWatch.detail: Saudi Arabia shut the 1,200km East-West pipeline (4-5m bpd, ~4% of global supply, the Hormuz bypass) on Sep 11 after drone attacks launched from Iraq's Maysan province; estimates say 3-5 weeks largely out of service. A vessel was struck in the Strait of Hormuz Sunday; Houthis hit Jazan. US slapped sanctions on a Russian bank; Vance confirmed direct US-Houthi talks over Mayyun (Perim) Island. Brent ~$106-108 (touched $110), WTI ~$101-102.

trumpWatch.title: Canada trade war: Section 338 product additions/removals effective today (Sep 15)
trumpWatch.detail: White House fact sheet (Sep 9): product additions and removals under the Section 338 proclamations take effect Sep 15, 2026; import bans follow Sep 29. A second supply-side price impulse landing in FOMC week. Kuala Lumpur Joint Arrangement still holds: China rare-earth export-control elimination and the US-China reciprocal-tariff truce run to Nov 10, 2026.
